purpose: Record the Operator's confirmed fallback IANA timezone, the zone used for calendar attribution only when source evidence lacks an experienced offset, as an append-only pending Fallback Timezone Policy through operational-store@5. A read-only plan validates the zone against the pinned tzdata release, checks the effective start, and works out which live policies the new one replaces; confirming that plan records the policy, and the store queues the affected reprocessing in the same transaction. Explicit source offsets stay authoritative. Activation with rebuilt results and a Cutover Record belongs to operational-store@6.

inputs.name: operator_request
inputs.description: The zone the Operator confirmed, as an IANA name; its effective start, either a timezone-aware instant no later than the request time or None for all earlier history; and the identities of any later live policies the Operator chose to replace as well.

inputs.name: confirmed_plan
inputs.description: The plan the Operator was shown and confirmed: the zone, the start in UTC, the later policies named for replacement, and the full list of policies the new one supersedes.

inputs.name: requested_at
inputs.description: The caller's timezone-aware Portal time for the plan or the confirmation, recorded as the policy's requested time.

inputs.name: policy_timeline
inputs.description: The live Fallback Timezone Policies read through operational-store@5's fallback_timezone_timeline in one read view, and the one policy written back through record_fallback_timezone_policy.

inputs.name: reprocessing_settings
inputs.description: The record-type-to-processor-version mapping and the attempt bound that the store uses to queue affected Processing Jobs, supplied by the caller from the portal-worker's own settings.

inputs.name: pinned_tzdata
inputs.description: The zone list of the pinned tzdata package (tzdata==2026.6, IANA release 2026f), read from the package itself and never from the host timezone database.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the store's filesystem, which the store compares with its reserve before a policy write.

outputs.name: allowed_zones
outputs.description: Every zone name the pinned tzdata package lists, links included, except Factory, in sorted order, for the Portal's zone picker.

outputs.name: timezone_plan
outputs.description: A read-only, health-data-free plan for one request: the validated zone, the start in UTC or None, the later policies named for replacement, and every live policy the new one would supersede, ascending. Planning writes nothing.

outputs.name: timezone_result
outputs.description: The recorded pending policy as operational-store@5 returns it, whether it was already recorded by an earlier attempt of the same plan, and the store's health-data-free counts of Processing Jobs queued and held leases marked; a repeat reports zero for both.

outputs.name: timezone_failure
outputs.description: A named refusal, conflict, or retryable failure that recorded nothing; its text is the failure name only and it carries no zone, time, projection, origin, or Source Identity.

observable_effects.name: fallback-timezone-policy-write
observable_effects.description: One pending Fallback Timezone Policy appended through operational-store@5's record_fallback_timezone_policy, superseding exactly the policies the confirmed plan names, with the store queuing the affected Processing Jobs and marking held leases in the same transaction; a refusal, conflict, retryable failure, or repeat of an already recorded plan commits nothing.

owns: which zone names are accepted, checked against the pinned tzdata package and never the host timezone database
the allowed effective start: all earlier history, or an instant no later than the request time
the rule that the first policy covers all earlier history
which live policies a new policy supersedes: the one with the same start automatically, later ones only when the Operator names them, earlier ones never
refusing a request that would change nothing
the read-only plan the Operator confirms, and refusing a confirmation whose plan no longer matches the timeline
recognizing a repeat of an already recorded plan after an uncertain commit
does_not_own: proposing a zone from the browser, presenting the plan, or collecting the Operator's confirmation, which the Phase 7 Portal page owns
storing policies, supersession links, overlap checks, identical-repeat detection by content, choosing the affected records, queuing their jobs, or marking held leases, which operational-store@5 owns
which timeline ordinary processing reads while a policy is pending, which execute-processing-job@2 and operational-store@6 own
policy activation, the active timeline, Cutover Targets, Cutover Records, Summary Refresh Jobs, or rebuilt Health Summaries, which operational-store@6 and the summary units own
the processor-version mapping and attempt bound, which the portal-worker's settings own
calendar attribution, policy identities, and the tzdata release in them, which interpret-source-projection@1 owns
withdrawing a policy without a replacement, Source Selection Policies, or privacy deletion of policies
